question: By what factor does scaled dot-product attention divide query-key dot products?
expected: By the square root of the key dimension, sqrt(d_k).
full_model_answer: In Scaled Dot-Product Attention, the query-key dot products are divided by $\sqrt{d_k}$ [Attention Is All You Need, PDF p. 4]. This scaling factor is applied to counteract the effect of dot products growing large in magnitude for large values of $d_k$, which would otherwise push the softmax function into regions with extremely small gradients [Attention Is All You Need, PDF p. 4][Attention Is All You Need, PDF p. 4]. The attention function is computed as $\text{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}(QK^T / \sqrt{d_k})V$ [Attention Is All You Need, PDF p. 4].
